body:
> **Question about InfoBox** : I am wondering how you make it work ([in this example](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=GeoSearch.with%20built-in%20marker%20%26%20InfoBox)) without referencing [InfoBox](https://github.com/googlemaps/v3-utility-library/tree/master/infobox) in your script?

Actually we are using the `InfoBox` in the examples. It's just that we don't use Google Maps globally, in order to avoid to load the library on all the examples. So we created a [simple wrapper](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/dev/app/utils/create-info-box.js) around the `InfoBox` to allow the loading of Google Maps asynchronously.

> **Question about MarkerClusterer** : I have been trying to add the [MarkerClusterer](https://github.com/googlemaps/v3-utility-library/tree/master/markerclusterer) with no success. Any tips?

We don't support the clustering out of the box with the built-in widget. For now you can use [the connector API](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors.html) in order to implement your own rendering. You will have a full control of what is render. So you can easily plug the clustering support. You can find an example of a custom widget with the `connectGeoSearch` connector [in our documentation](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectGeoSearch.html#example).
